send a chill down one's spine: The strange noise coming from the empty classroom at midnight sent a chill down my spine.
午夜從空教室傳來的怪聲讓我脊背發涼。
a chill in the air: Autumn is coming; you can feel a chill in the air in the early morning, so bring a jacket.
秋天要來了；清晨你能感受到空氣中的寒意，所以帶件外套吧。
chill out: You have studied for six hours, so take a break and chill out with some music before dinner.
你已經讀了六個小時的書，所以休息一下，晚餐前聽點音樂放鬆。
a chilly reception: Her idea of cutting the class trip got a chilly reception from the students, who simply stared at her.
她取消校外旅行的提議受到學生冷淡的接待，大家只是盯著她看。
a chilly atmosphere: After the two sisters argued, there was a chilly atmosphere at dinner, and nobody said a word.
兩姊妹吵架後，晚餐時氣氛冷冰冰的，沒有人說一句話。
feel chilly: I always feel chilly in the library because the air conditioner is set too low, so I bring a sweater.
我在圖書館總是覺得冷，因為冷氣開得太低，所以我會帶件毛衣。
chronic disease: My grandfather has a chronic disease, so he must take medicine every day for the rest of his life.
我爺爺有慢性病，所以他餘生每天都必須吃藥。
a chronic shortage: Many rural hospitals face a chronic shortage of nurses, which has lasted for more than ten years.
許多鄉下醫院面臨護理師長期短缺的問題，已經持續超過十年了。
chronic unemployment: The factory closed years ago, and the small town has suffered from chronic unemployment ever since.
那間工廠多年前就關了，這個小鎮從那時起便深受長期失業之苦。
a chronic liar: Nobody believes Tom anymore because he is a chronic liar who lies every day, even about tiny things.
沒有人再相信湯姆了，因為他是個慣性說謊者，每天都說謊，連小事也不例外。
a circular argument: Saying the book is true because the book says so is a circular argument that proves nothing.
說這本書是真的因為書上這麼說，是一種什麼也證明不了的循環論證。
a circular letter: The principal sent a circular letter to all parents, explaining the new rules for school uniforms.
校長寄了一封通函給所有家長，說明制服的新規定。
a circular route: The tourist bus follows a circular route, so it starts and ends at the same train station.
這輛觀光巴士走環狀路線，所以它在同一個火車站出發也在那裡結束。
civic duty: Voting in elections is a civic duty, so every citizen over eighteen should take part.
在選舉中投票是公民義務，所以每位滿十八歲的公民都應該參與。
civic pride: The residents showed great civic pride by cleaning the streets and planting flowers before the city festival.
居民們在市慶前清掃街道、種花，展現了對家鄉的強烈自豪。
the civic center: The concert will be held at the civic center downtown, where most public events in our city take place.
音樂會將在市中心的市民中心舉行，我們市裡大部分的公共活動都在那裡舉辦。
civic education: Through civic education, students learn about the law, voting, and their rights as citizens.
透過公民教育，學生學習法律、投票以及身為公民的權利。
civil rights: Martin Luther King Jr. fought for civil rights so that Black Americans could be treated equally.
馬丁·路德·金恩為公民權而奮鬥，讓美國黑人能受到平等對待。
a civil war: The country was divided by a civil war in which soldiers from the same nation fought each other.
這個國家因一場內戰而分裂，同一國家的士兵彼此交戰。
civil servants: Civil servants such as police officers and clerks work for the government and serve the public.
像警察和辦事員這樣的公務員為政府工作，為大眾服務。
civil law: Problems between neighbors, such as broken contracts or property disputes, are usually handled under civil law.
鄰居間的問題，例如違約或財產糾紛，通常依民法處理。
be civil to someone: Even if you dislike your new classmate, you should be civil to him and greet him politely.
即使你不喜歡新同學，你也應該對他客氣有禮，禮貌地跟他打招呼。
civil engineering: My brother studies civil engineering because he wants to design bridges, roads, and tunnels in the future.
我哥哥唸土木工程，因為他將來想設計橋樑、道路和隧道。
civil disobedience: The protesters chose civil disobedience, peacefully refusing to obey a law they believed was unfair.
抗議者選擇公民不服從，和平地拒絕遵守他們認為不公平的法律。
civilian casualties: The bombing caused heavy civilian casualties, as most of the dead were ordinary people, not soldiers.
這場轟炸造成大量平民傷亡，因為大多數死者是一般百姓，而非士兵。
civilian life: After twenty years in the army, my uncle found it hard to return to civilian life and find a normal job.
在軍中待了二十年後，我叔叔發現很難回到平民生活並找份普通工作。
in civilian clothes: The police officer was in civilian clothes, so nobody at the market knew he was watching the thief.
那位警察穿著便服，所以市場裡沒有人知道他正在監視那個小偷。
clinical trials: Before a new medicine is sold, it must pass clinical trials in which doctors test it on patients.
新藥上市前必須通過臨床試驗，由醫生在病人身上進行測試。
a clinical approach: The judge took a clinical approach to the case, looking only at the facts and ignoring her own feelings.
法官對這個案子採取冷靜客觀的態度，只看事實而不理會自己的感受。
clinical depression: She was not just sad for a few days; the doctor said she had clinical depression and needed treatment.
她不只是難過幾天而已；醫生說她患有臨床憂鬱症，需要接受治療。
in a clinical manner: He announced that fifty workers would lose their jobs in a clinical manner, without any warmth or sympathy.
他以冷漠無情的方式宣布五十名員工將失去工作，毫無溫情或同情。
